evals.prompt: Adopt the harness in an empty greenfield repository. What must be proven before any work starts?
evals.expected_output: do-harness init scaffolds the workspace plus a minimal rust crate, then do-harness verify must actually execute every sensor and exit 0 — the green path is computed, never assumed. A subsequently failing sensor records its error signature for the fail-fast lifecycle.

evals.prompt: The same test has failed 3 consecutive times for the same subtask. What now?
evals.expected_output: Apply the fail-fast policy: halt, record the error signature, and surface a diagnostic to the developer.

evals.prompt: Explain what a for-loop is. No repository or workspace is involved.
evals.expected_output: No harness action: general knowledge needs no init, no sensors run, and no workspace is touched.
